video_title: Yaxel Lendeborg Gets Lessons on the Bay with Aaron Gordon & Drew Gooden Rookie Dinner | Episode 1

quotes.speaker: Drew Gooden
quotes.summary_phrase: Drew Gooden's advice on managing NBA success and wealth
quotes.excerpt: Don't be in a rush to go broke to impress people that's broke.
quotes.quote: Don't be in a rush to go broke to impress people that's broke. And then don't be in a rush to show people that got money that you got money, because their money be longer.

quotes.speaker: Drew Gooden
quotes.summary_phrase: Drew Gooden on the history of the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Warriors had a cool run with Run TMC with Chris Mullin, Tim Hardaway, and Mitch Richmond.
quotes.quote: When I was coming up as a kid, Warriors had a cool run with Run TMC with Chris Mullin, Tim Hardaway, and Mitch Richmond. Yes, they had a little one right there, had a little pocket. Then the Don Nelson teams, they had a lot of talent, but they just couldn't get over that hump.

quotes.speaker: Drew Gooden
quotes.summary_phrase: Drew Gooden on the evolution of rookie duties
quotes.excerpt: When I was a rookie, when we landed in the city, it could be snowing.
quotes.quote: When I was a rookie, when we landed in the city, it could be snowing. Rookies had to help the trainers and equipment with the bags to the plane and the bus. I guess it's a rookie class action lawsuit came out or something, but something happened, man. Somebody must have called a case and cracked down.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on rookie hazing and popcorn pranks
quotes.excerpt: I see somebody get taped to their chair in the locker room, all that, popcorn cars.
quotes.quote: I see somebody get taped to their chair in the locker room, all that, popcorn cars. I want to do that to you, you can't do that anymore. That car would smell like a movie theater for months.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.excerpt: One of the rookies was talking shit, I had his car towed.
quotes.quote: One of the rookies was talking shit, I had his car towed. And I just put it on the other side of the parking lot so he thought it was stolen.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg's commitment to cancer awareness
quotes.excerpt: I'm trying to help out with cancer, my mom has cancer, so anything involving that.
quotes.quote: I'm trying to help out with cancer, my mom has cancer, so anything involving that, I try to donate, try to bring awareness to it.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg on Michigan's championship team culture
quotes.excerpt: Everybody was sacrificing stats, you know, for the ultimate win.
quotes.quote: Everybody was sacrificing stats, you know, for the ultimate win, you know, nobody thought they were better than anybody else.

quotes.speaker: Drew Gooden
quotes.summary_phrase: Drew Gooden on the difficulty of replicating college success
quotes.excerpt: It's kind of hard to replicate that at the NBA level.
quotes.quote: It's kind of hard to replicate that at the NBA level, where everybody's like, you know what, I'm going to sacrifice these numbers. We got one goal, that's winning the championship.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on the competitive nature of young NBA teams
quotes.excerpt: We had all young cats, we was 18, 19, 20, everybody's competing with each other for a contract.
quotes.quote: We were in Orlando, we had all young cats, we was 18, 19, 20, everybody's competing with each other for a contract. You're competing with your own team. Everybody got families to feed, man.

quotes.speaker: Drew Gooden
quotes.summary_phrase: Drew Gooden on sacrificing stats for team success
quotes.excerpt: I played four years with LeBron in Cleveland and we went to the NBA Finals.
quotes.quote: I played four years with LeBron in Cleveland and we went to the NBA Finals in 2007. I had to just become a double-double guy. And when I sacrificed just the 10 and 10, they were telling me that I was having a better year that year going to the finals than I did the previous year averaging 15 plus.

quotes.speaker: Drew Gooden
quotes.summary_phrase: Drew Gooden on the history of the Oakland Soldiers
quotes.excerpt: LeBron played on the AU team, he played, I played, Leon Powe, Chuck Hayes.
quotes.quote: LeBron played on the AU team, he played, I played, Leon Powe, Chuck Hayes. We had a lot of NBA guys that came through that program.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on learning from generational talent
quotes.excerpt: Playing with generational talents like Steph Curry and Nikola Jokic makes the game hell of easy.
quotes.quote: Playing with generational talents like Steph Curry and Nikola Jokic makes the game hell of easy, bro. Watch how he works and then just start polling from it.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on the reciprocity of team play
quotes.excerpt: The more you give out, the more that comes back around.
quotes.quote: The more you give out, the more that comes back around. But I think it's a blessing like you said to be able to see how they work because Bron busts his ass.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on the importance of mental decompression
quotes.excerpt: There's a fine line of like obsession over this game. If you want to be great.
quotes.quote: There's a fine line of like obsession over this game. If you want to be great, you got to have your decompression, you know what I mean? Because there's so much that this winds you up, winds you up, winds you up, you be too tight and too stiff out there.

quotes.speaker: Mistah F.A.B.
quotes.summary_phrase: Mistah F.A.B. on the importance of authenticity in community work
quotes.excerpt: If you do have any aspirations of showing up in some of these areas, just be authentic.
quotes.quote: If you do have any aspirations of showing up in some of these areas where there's underserved communities, just be authentic. Not even coming with the cameras. Two summers ago, I rebuilt the neighborhood basketball court that I grew up playing on. Steph came out, played basketball with the kids.

quotes.speaker: Mistah F.A.B.
quotes.summary_phrase: Mistah F.A.B. on his personal growth and past arrogance
quotes.excerpt: I've gone through blessed to live long enough to go through a lot of different phases.
quotes.quote: I've gone through blessed to live long enough to go through a lot of different phases of being a young arrogant guy just because I felt like I was deflecting to protect me from my insecurities. I seen Hammer come through in Ferraris. MC Hammer as a kid, watching Hammer pull up down the street in a Ferrari with 20 cars behind him. To me that was like, that's what I wanted to do.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on the shift from materialism to purpose
quotes.excerpt: When you first get into the game, yeah, it's about like the glitz and glamour, the materialism.
quotes.quote: When you first get into the game, yeah, it's about like the glitz and glamour, the materialism, like what car you have, what chain you have, what bitch you have, what girl you have, whatever, you know what I mean? But as you get older, you start to understand, fuck what I got on, you know what I mean? I don't really give a shit. I walk around with fucking in sweats and slippers and a sweatshirt, you know what I mean? Because I know that I got my family out of debt.
